offline_diagnostic_basis.causal_read: The exception, restoration under-recall, and control false activation are separate mechanisms and must not share a single threshold or veto.

v8_mechanism.name: component-scoped-restoration-with-independent-compatibility
v8_mechanism.v7_reuse_policy: Do not execute or import v7 as a candidate parser. Re-express only the frozen supported mechanisms and conflict predicates specified here, so the frozen E6 exception cannot be inherited.
v8_mechanism.selection_unit: One connected structural delta component and its minimal referential closure, never a whole clause and never an expected-output-selected node.

ordered_stages.name: load_frozen_candidate_graphs
ordered_stages.rule: Obtain frozen v4, v5, and v6 graphs for identical parser inputs. The selector receives only source characters, spans, graph roles, references, and frozen parser provenance.

ordered_stages.name: normalize_typed_envelope_inputs
ordered_stages.rule: Every envelope constructor accepts SourceSpan values only. Convert a wrapper explicitly to its marker and content spans before E6 envelope construction; reject any structural object passed as a span.
ordered_stages.frozen_E6_signature: Keep the prior deictic-header, separator, direct open-list, and priority-tail requirements unchanged.

ordered_stages.name: build_delta_component_graph
ordered_stages.rule: Represent every v5-v6 and v4-v6 node delta explicitly. Connect nodes only by exact shared boundary, wrapper ownership, coordination membership, scope target, attachment edge, or exact producer span. Plain region co-membership and broad envelope containment do not create an edge.

ordered_stages.name: certify_supported_v5_activation
ordered_stages.rule: A v5 component is activation-eligible only when it contains a frozen E2, E3, E6, or E7 witness and the changed nodes are in the witness's structural dependency closure. E2 requires a changed wrapper boundary used by a changed member, scope, attachment, or producer. E3 requires a changed connector role corroborated by the same changed coordination or attachment topology. E6 and E7 keep their previously frozen exact structural signatures.
ordered_stages.forbidden_shortcut: A node is not licensed merely because its span lies inside a witness envelope.

ordered_stages.name: apply_independent_v6_compatibility_veto
ordered_stages.rule: Even an activation-eligible component stays v6 if v5 deletes a complete v6 surface partition, performs an unsupported surface-to-example role transfer, loses or reparents a protected attachment, contaminates an atomic producer with a wrapper or operator, changes a scope-bearing atom outside dependency closure, or fails to repair the local structural inconsistency named by its witness.
ordered_stages.independence: Activation asks whether a supported mechanism is present; compatibility separately asks whether applying it conserves every unimplicated v6 producer and reference. Both must pass.

ordered_stages.name: restore_supported_component_closure
ordered_stages.rule: Use v5 only for a certified, compatible component and its minimal reference closure. Partial family deltas outside that component stay v6; a separate certified component is not rejected because another component in the same family is unlicensed.

ordered_stages.name: route_conflicts_component_locally
ordered_stages.rule: Evaluate the frozen S3, S1, and S2 predicates independently per connected component. A conflict may route only its registered family bundle and may not veto disjoint supported restoration. Within the same component, a certified compatible supported restoration defeats S2; otherwise the frozen S3, S1, S2 order is retained.
ordered_stages.S2_specificity_guard: S2 may replace a producer only when the v4 counterpart is a complete source-covering counterpart for the minimal changed component and the replacement preserves all exact v6 families outside it.

ordered_stages.name: merge_validate_and_project_once
ordered_stages.rule: Rebase ids by exact source span, reject dangling or multiply-owned references, validate anchoring and unique ids, then derive both projections exactly once from the merged graph.

precedence: source anchoring, typed spans, graph validity, and reference closure
S3 conflict bundle outside certified supported components
S1 conflict bundle outside certified supported components
S2 producer replacement outside certified supported components
runtime_prohibitions: record identifiers, file paths, expected outputs, or evaluation metadata
memorized long source substrings or named-entity exceptions
whole-clause veto or whole-family replacement caused only by containment

requirements: All frozen input hashes and frozen v4-v7 source hashes match.
Every v8 output parses, validates, is source-anchored, and has closed references.
Model and network call counts are zero.

G1-v7-behavioral-gates-not-weakened.requirement: Run every v7 G0-G7 behavioral criterion with identical operators and numeric thresholds; all must pass. The implementation-specific v7 G8 fixed trace shape is superseded, not weakened, by the v8 G9 component-trace, static-audit, and test requirements.

G3-v5-mechanism-preservation.requirement: 20/20 exact on wrappers, connector roles, coordination members, scope edges, attachment parents and edges, item candidates, and both projections.

requirements: Every aggregate primary metric is no worse than frozen v4 and frozen v6.
Every per-record primary-layer difference is no greater than frozen v4 and frozen v6.
The previously registered open-list wrapper regression remains zero.
All existing structured-span tests pass unchanged.
Synthetic tests cover the typed E6 path, each activation witness, each compatibility veto, component separation, overlap precedence, and reference closure.
Every trace records component envelope, witness, compatibility result, family origin, and final selection.
A static audit rejects runtime record identifiers, evaluation metadata, job metadata dispatch, long source literals, canonicalization, and network or model imports.

evaluation_protocol.failure_policy: Freeze failed v8 raw and report. Do not modify or rerun v8, add an exception, or relax a gate; diagnose offline and preregister a new version.

post_gate_protocol.on_pass: Freeze v8 and collect a separately preregistered fresh external blind holdout before any canonicalizer work.
post_gate_protocol.on_fail: Keep the current production reference and use only frozen raw for the next diagnosis.
post_gate_protocol.canonicalizer_unlock_condition: Only a separately frozen fresh external blind-holdout pass.
